KEINEMOD-CONSUME.description: Move cards into your [gold]Scroll[/gold], trigger their [gold]Consumed[/gold] effects.
KEINEMOD-CONSUME.title: Consume
Consume.tlnotes: Consume here means to eat up. Keine's title in 求聞史紀 is 歴史喰いの半獣, ideally this should be the same the wording of her title. In English, I used Consume rather than Eat because Consume has feels more like a card-game word. I saw you used Record instead, in the end it is up to you which one to use.
KEINEMOD-CREATE.description: Add cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold], Non-Status cards added gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
KEINEMOD-CREATE.title: Create
KEINEMOD-RECALL.description: Move cards from your [gold]Scroll[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold], they cost [blue]1[/blue] less this turn and gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
KEINEMOD-RECALL.title: Recall
Recall.tlnotes: I saw you used 想起, which is more related to Satori I guess (it is the prefix for most of her spell cards). Recall here is more like resurface, recollect, or reappear. The Chinese I used for this is 重现, for reference.
KEINEMOD-HUMAN.title: Human
KEINEMOD-HAKUTAKU.description: Your beast form. Whenever you enter [green]Hakutaku[/green] form, [gold]Recall[/gold] up to [blue]2[/blue] cards.
KEINEMOD-HAKUTAKU.title: Hakutaku
KEINEMOD-FULLMOON.description: Once per turn: you can click on [gold]Full Moon[/gold], spending [blue]1[/blue] stack and enter [green]Hakutaku[/green] form this turn.
KEINEMOD-FULLMOON.title: Full Moon
KEINEMOD-KNOWLEDGEABLE.description: This card's damage and [gold]Block[/gold] scales with your [gold]Knowledge[/gold].
KEINEMOD-KNOWLEDGEABLE.title: Knowledgeable
KEINEMOD-SACREDSCROLL.title: Sacred Scroll
KEINEMOD-SACREDPOWER.description:
Scroll of Valor - [red]Strength[/red]
Scroll of Benevolence - [green]Dexterity[/green]
Scroll of Wisdom - [blue]Knowledge[/blue]
KEINEMOD-SACREDPOWER.title: Sacred Power
SacredPower.tlnotes: Short for Sacred Treasure's Power, I saw you corrected expanded it, well done.
KEINEMOD-REINCARNATION.description: A part of the Boss's abilities. Each Boss has its unique [gold]Reincarnation[/gold], can be viewed by a power on them during Boss fights.
KEINEMOD-REINCARNATION.title: Reincarnation
Reincarnation.tlnotes: 転世「一条戻り橋」 is the Spell Card, so use 転世 here.
